parsed.post: Kept DEPTH=10: val_bpb improved from 0.987592 to 0.980053. Scaling depth continues to provide gains despite potential step count reduction. Next: lowering MATRIX_LR to 0.04 to follow the team trend of finding better stability and convergence with lower learning rates at higher depths.
parsed.description: Lowering MATRIX_LR to 0.04 at DEPTH=10 to follow the team trend of stability gains with lower learning rates.
